import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int M1 = 998244353;
    static final int M2 = 1000000007;
    static final int B = 1000000;
    static List<Integer>[] arr = new ArrayList[7];
    static int[] prefixSum = new int[7];
    static long limit;
    static long counter, result;

    public static void buildTree(int level, int prefix) {
        counter++;
        int val = (int)((counter - prefix + M1) % M1);
        arr[level].add(val);
        prefixSum[level] = (int)((prefixSum[level] + val) % M2);
        if (level == 6) return;
        for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
            buildTree(level + 1, prefix * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    public static void traverse(long x) {
        if (x > limit) return;
        if (x * B + B - 1 <= limit && x * B * 10 > limit) {
            long currentCount = counter;
            for (int i = 0, factor = 1; i <= 6; i++, factor *= 10) {
                int size = arr[i].size();
                int diffVal = (int)(((currentCount - x * factor) % M1 + M1) % M1);
                int pos = lowerBound(arr[i], M1 - diffVal);
                result = (result + (long)diffVal * size + prefixSum[i]) % M2;
                result = (result - (long)M1 * (size - pos) % M2 + M2) % M2;
                counter += size;
            }
            return;
        }
        counter++;
        result = (result + ((counter - x) % M1 + M1) % M1) % M2;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            traverse(x * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    public static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        limit = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            arr[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        buildTree(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(arr[i]);
        }
        counter = 0;
        result = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            traverse(i);
        }
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
